gaps.sentence: They elected her ___ chairperson for a second term.
gaps.explanation: After 'elect/appoint', roles take no article: elected her chairperson.

gaps.sentence: We visited ___ Louvre on our last morning in Paris.
gaps.explanation: Most famous buildings and monuments take 'the': the Louvre, the Eiffel Tower.

gaps.sentence: She goes to ___ school by bus every morning.
gaps.explanation: 'Go to school/work/bed/church' (as participant) takes no article.

gaps.sentence: He's always been fascinated by ___ universe.
It's ___ eight o'clock news — hurry up!
gaps.explanation: 'The eight o'clock news' — a specific, known programme.
Both 'happiness' and 'money' are general here, so no article for either gap.

gaps.sentence: ___ rich variety of birds lives in the Danube delta.
gaps.explanation: A rich variety of… — variety is countable here, first mention.

gaps.sentence: They're building ___ new library near the town hall.
gaps.explanation: A new library — first mention; the town hall is the known one.
